newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index dives 2.60 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index dives 2.60 pct in late trade.

text.p: The Manila share index fell 70.36 points, or 2.60 percent, to 2,635.56 points in late trade on fears the Philippines would follow Thailand's latest financial woes, brokers said,

"The comparison is rather unfair. But if the Central Bank raises interest rates, then people would rather switch to fixed-income," said Corazon Guidote, head of Phlippine quities at UBS Securities (East Asia) Ltd.
"It is spillover of sentiment concerning Thailand," said Dennis Rayala, research head at Abacus Securities.
On Wednesday, there was speculation that the baht would be devalued.
The Thailand government has dismissed talk of devaluation as some Asian nations, including the Philippines, moved to protect their own currencies from speculative attack.
